subject: Staged downsell playbook: approval request for early-unwind protections
messages:
From: Susan Hart <susan.hart@bluecorehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@bluecorehealth.com
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: staged downsell and ramp protections

Hi Markus / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed with our procurement team, BlueCore needs an amendment that lets us scale down during the first year without triggering full early-termination penalties. High level asks from legal and finance: 

- A short grace window for the first 90 days where we can downscale up to two reserved capacity tiers without an early-termination fee, subject to a staged ramp schedule.
- If usage stays below 30% of committed throughput for two consecutive 30-day periods after the grace window, an opt-out clause to terminate with a prorated credit.
- A one-time transition credit to offset migration costs for our engineers (BlueCore proposes a 25% credit on remaining committed spend).

I've attached a redline proposal and Q1 usage that justify the ask. We know this is non-standard; want to surface it for exec approval and see what limited concessions Redwood can offer.

Can you advise on what level of approval you need and whether Redwood would accept a 60–90 day staged ramp instead of the 180-day standard?

Appreciate a quick read — we are hoping to finalize the amendment by month-end.

Best,
Susan Hart
Director, Strategic Procurement
BlueCore Health
Attachments: BlueCore_Proposed_Amendment_20280321.pdf (redline), usage_report_q1_2028.csv
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: staged downsell and ramp protections

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding BlueCore's request (below). They want an early-downsize path with a staged ramp and a transition credit. My read: BlueCore is strategic in health vertical (long-term expansion potential) but the ask is material to committed economics.

Recommendation for exec signoff:
- Approve a limited staged-ramp carve-out: 60-day grace window + 60-day staged ramp (two 30-day observation windows) rather than an open 90/180.
- Offer a capped one-time transition credit at 20% of remaining committed value (instead of their 25%), tied to execution milestones (signed amendment + migration plan accepted).
- If usage <30% for two consecutive 30-day windows after ramp, allow termination with prorated credit equal to unused commitment less applied credit; no further refunds.

Risks: sets a precedent for future early-downsize requests. Controls recommended: require a migration plan, limit to one exercise of opt-out in the first contract year, and require legal to add strict measurement definitions (which Jonas can handle).

Please reply with approval text or alternate amounts; if OK I will ask Legal to draft amendment and Aditya to confirm accounting treatment.

-Markus

Markus — thanks for the summary and recommended guardrails. My stance: we should be willing to make a pragmatic concession for a strategic health customer, but we must protect revenue and precedent.

Approve in principle with these changes:
- Transition credit: 20% one-time credit capped at $75k (whichever is lower).
- Grace + staged ramp: 60-day initial grace where they can downscale one tier; followed by a second 60-day measurement window for further reduction.
- Opt-out: allowed only if usage <25% for two consecutive 30-day windows after the staged ramp.
- Limit: only one exercise of the opt-out during the first 12 months.

Next steps: Aditya — can you confirm accounting and whether finance can accept 20% capped credits (impact to revenue recognition)? Jonas — please draft the amendment with measurement language and required migration milestones. I'll communicate these points to BlueCore and ask for confirmation against their migration plan.

Also linking HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6789012

-Marissa

Team — I reviewed the proposed economics and Marissa's adjustments. Finance will approve the concession with the following finalizations:

- Transition credit: 20% capped at $75,000. Treat as a contra-revenue item amortized over the remainder of the commitment term.
- Measurement: we will accept the <25% usage trigger (two consecutive 30-day periods) as long as measurement methodology is documented and data feed is mutually agreed. Jonas, please add SLA for reporting cadence and definitions.
- Opt-out: permitted once in the first 12 months; termination will result in prorated refund less applied credits.

Jonas / Legal: please prepare the amendment and a clean redline. Once ready, send DocuSign to BlueCore Legal. I'll approve execution after legal confirms accounting treatment in the amendment language.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/s/abcd-BlueCore-amendment

Thanks — Aditya
